paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -1.81% on average, with Hang Seng strongest (+1.67%) and Nasdaq weakest (-5.52%). Brent crude changed +4.89% to 99.25. Gold changed +0.61% to 4,097.8999. Bitcoin changed -5.64% to 75,873.9219. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.837%, a relative move of -1.16%. Among the firms tracked, Invesco (-8.02%) and Freeport-McMoRan (-7.51%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Monzo explores fundraising at £7.5bn valuation as private equity talks stall (FT Markets). Lender had shifted focus to talks with buyout groups after failing to clinch a £10bn takeover by Brazilian fintech Nubank Deals and capital markets: Wendy's rejects $1.4 billion takeover proposal from Nelson Peltz’s Trian (CNBC). Wendy's said the $1.4 billion takeover proposal does not reflect potential gains from the burger chain's turnaround strategy. Central banks and macro: Three ways the interest rate rise could affect you (BBC Business). Job, loans and savings are all affected by the rise in interest rates announced by the Bank of England. Central banks and macro: Bank rate rise ‘puts tracker mortgage trend at risk’ (FT World). Most fixed-rate borrowers are cushioned from the impact of this week’s decision but those coming off a five-year deal face a payment shock Geopolitics and trade: Vance blames Iran war for crushing Republican midterms defeat (FT World). Oil prices tumble as Democrats’ landslide victory piles pressure on Donald Trump to end Middle East conflict
